title: Instagram-style app UI
summary: Generic Instagram-style app screens for talking-head footage: the comments sheet with a keyword typed and posted plus the auto-DM notification, a phone card swiping through reel covers with view counts, and a reel-insights card that counts up. Drawn in code (no logos or real app assets); the user's handle and photo are props. Any footage storyboard borrows a piece with "theme": "ui/instagram".
